about: Totem's ad lot list (Phase 1 of docs/roadmap/ad-auction.md): the same list for everyone, shipped inside the app and served read-only at /ads/lots.json. Each device picks from it for the mode it is in; nobody is told which ad a device showed. TO CHANGE THE HOUSE AD: edit the advertiser and creative of both lots below, run `npm run ads:approve` to see them against the policy, then `npm run ads:approve -- --yes` to sign the new words (until it is signed again an edited lot is not shown), then rebuild and deploy.

creative.headline: Your project could be here
creative.body: A house ad: the slot Totem keeps for its own projects. Ads here are picked on your device for the mode you're in, and you set how many per mode in Settings.
